title: Vinod Khosla: AI could replace 65% of all jobs within 20 years
source_used: Yahoo video page (description only; no article text, no other outlet found)
key_facts: At the Masters of Scale Summit, venture capitalist Vinod Khosla argues that AI could handle 65% of all jobs within two decades.
He says that is not necessarily bad, because economic abundance could let everyone stop working jobs they hate.
quote_evidence: At Masters of Scale Summit, venture capital legend Vinod Khosla argues that AI could handle 65% of all jobs within two decades.
He says that's not necessarily bad, predicting enough economic abundance for everyone to stop working jobs they hate and focus on what they love.
why_it_matters_hint: A venture capitalist's long-range forecast of job loss, with abundance as his answer, but no evidence in the text we could read.
notes: Only a 273-character video description was readable. Headline 'could replace 65% of all jobs' is stronger than the description's 'could handle 65% of all jobs', so the score is lowered 6 to 5 (-1). Khosla's organisation is not stated in the text.
